2. Replace all non-alphanumeric characters (including underscores) with hyphens
3. Collapse multiple consecutive hyphens into one
4. Remove leading/trailing hyphens

","source":"export function slugify(value: string): string {
  const lower = value.toLowerCase();
  const withHyphens = lower.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-');
  return withHyphens.replace(/^[-]+|[-]+$/g, '').replace(/[-]{2,}/g, '-');
}"}

All tests passed. The slugify function now correctly:
- Converts to lowercase
- Collapses all punctuation/whitespace/underscores into single hyphens
- Removes leading/trailing hyphens
- Preserves digits
- Returns empty string for punctuation-only input
